parsed.note: The proposal only scales model depth/aspect ratio and adds warmup; it leaves TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' disjoint from EVAL_SHARD=10 and does not touch the fixed evaluation block, so val_bpb still measures genuine held-out quality.
